newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Lombard rate jumps to 682.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Romania Lombard rate jumps to 682.4 percent.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday the Lombard rate had jumped to 682.4 percent from 362.16 percent previously, following a rise in the average rate on one-week refinancing funds.
The Lombard rate, set weekly by multiplying the average auctioned rate by 1.6, is charged on overdraft credits.
The one-week rate surged to 426.50 percent on Thursday from 226.35 percent last week under oversubscription of the BNR refinancing offer on a money market facing liquidity shortages.
Interbank money market traders said they expected short-term prices to climb on Friday against around 345 percent on Thursday.

The central bank is determined to go ahead with plans to use monetary policy to curb inflation and restore confidence in the leu, whose reference rate has sunk by more than 90 percent to 7,744 to the dollar since January 1.
